'''Taggon''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], and was home to the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and [[House D'Vails]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was the site of a number of factories and warehouses.
